This is my main maize plot, so I must take care of it even though I am old now. I will use the improved seed from the cooperative and apply both chemical fertilizer—maybe urea and DAP—and cow manure, because maize needs strength to grow well on this small land. My children and grandchildren will do the heavy work of ploughing and weeding, but I may need to hire a young man with oxen for a day or two since I cannot manage the ploughing myself. I do not have money for pesticides or herbicides, and we depend entirely on the rains from God, not irrigation.
